title: Dashboard Injury

positions.as_written: Ask whether the knee was bent and whether something struck the front of the shin rather than the knee itself.
Ask about the energy: a road traffic collision, a fall from height, or a sporting impact.
Ask about the hip and the femur, because a posteriorly directed force on a flexed knee also loads them and a hip dislocation or femoral fracture takes priority.
Ask about the foot and ankle, which are injured in the same events and are frequently missed.
Ask about numbness, tingling or weakness, and whether the knee was ever obviously out of shape.
